panels.description: Latest completed-epoch Trillium MEV, block-reward, transaction, and compute analytics for the configured economics validator.
panels.title: Completed-Epoch MEV Capture

options.content: [Data: Trillium](https://trillium.so) · CC BY 4.0. Values describe the latest completed epoch, not current-epoch accrual. No data means economics mode is disabled, the Trillium route is unconfigured or unavailable, or Trillium has no record for the target in its latest ten completed epochs.

panels.description: Completed epoch represented by every Trillium panel.
panels.title: Published Epoch

panels.description: Gross Jito tip deposits before block-engine and tip-router fees.
panels.title: Gross Jito Tips

panels.description: Total MEV captured by the validator's blocks according to Trillium's mev_earned field.
panels.title: MEV Captured

panels.description: MEV captured per assigned leader slot; skipped slots count as zero.
panels.title: MEV / Leader Slot

panels.description: Validator MEV commission for the represented epoch.
panels.title: MEV Commission

panels.description: Jito tip transactions observed in the represented epoch.
panels.title: Jito Tip Transactions

panels.description: Gross Jito tips, allocations, and fee amounts remain independent published fields; compare them without inferring an exact accounting identity.
panels.title: Capture Flow

panels.description: Latest completed-epoch values by destination. Jito block-engine and tip-router fees are separate stages in the capture flow.
panels.title: MEV Allocation and Fees

panels.description: Gross Jito tip deposits compared with Trillium's published MEV captured value.
panels.title: Gross Tips and MEV Captured

panels.description: Blocks produced as a percentage of assigned leader slots in the represented epoch.
panels.title: Produced / Assigned

panels.description: Ratio of Trillium's published mev_earned value to gross Jito tips. This ratio does not identify an individual fee. A zero-gross epoch renders zero.
panels.title: Published MEV / Gross Tips

panels.description: Share of captured MEV allocated to the validator after commission and tip-router handling.
panels.title: Validator Share of Capture

panels.description: Completed-epoch block rewards, priority fees, signature fees, and per-block distributions published by Trillium.
panels.title: Block Rewards and Priority Fees

panels.description: Independent completed-epoch block-reward amounts. Components are not forced into an accounting identity.
panels.title: Block Reward Components

panels.description: Average and median MEV, priority-fee, signature-fee, and gross Jito-tip amounts per produced block.
panels.title: Per-Block Rewards

panels.description: Activated stake represented by Trillium's completed-epoch record.
panels.title: Activated Stake

panels.description: Validator priority-fee commission converted from Trillium basis points to percent.
panels.title: Priority Fee Commission

panels.description: Completed-epoch transaction outcomes, block throughput, success rates, and compute consumption published by Trillium.
panels.title: Transactions and Compute

panels.description: Successful and failed transactions for all traffic and user traffic in produced blocks.
panels.title: Transaction Outcomes

panels.description: Average and median transaction throughput per produced block, split where Trillium publishes a transaction type.
panels.title: Transactions / Block

panels.description: Average completed-epoch transaction success rates for all and user transactions.
panels.title: Transaction Success

panels.description: Average and median compute units consumed per produced block.
panels.title: Compute Units / Block

panels.description: Prometheus retains each latest completed-epoch value over scrape time; step changes occur when Trillium publishes or corrects an epoch.
panels.title: History

panels.description: Latest completed-epoch gross Jito tips and published MEV capture over observation time.
panels.title: MEV Capture History

panels.description: Stake-honest MEV capture rate; assigned skipped slots count as zero.
panels.title: MEV per Leader Slot History

panels.description: Validator, staker, block-engine, and tip-router values over observation time.
panels.title: Allocation and Fee History

panels.description: Commission associated with each latest completed-epoch capture.
panels.title: MEV Commission History

panels.description: Collection availability, watcher freshness, and the selected Trillium connector are independent signals.
panels.title: Availability and Source

panels.description: Disabled, down, up, or pending based on economics mode state.

targets.expr: max by (network) (sol_mode_enabled{network="$network",mode="economics"}) * ((1 + max by (network) (sol_mode_up{network="$network",mode="economics"})) or (3 * max by (network) (sol_mode_enabled{network="$network",mode="economics"})))

panels.title: Economics Mode

panels.description: Seconds since the last complete watcher snapshot; Trillium absence alone does not make required economics collection fail.
panels.title: Snapshot Age

panels.description: Connector that supplied the latest Trillium command result. A valid provider response with no target record still identifies its source; no row means every configured attempt failed or the route is absent.
panels.title: Selected Trillium Source
